column1: # manifests/sid-exceptions.tsv -- the reviewed ledger of installer-substrate
# packages that are authorized from the pinned snapshot's sid debian-installer
# suite INSTEAD of from forky.  This REPLACES any blanket suite grant: the
# provenance gate authorizes sid d-i ONLY for an exact (name,version,arch,sha256)
# row here, and each row is chained to the signed sid index at the pinned
# d-i package NOT in this ledger FAILS.  A row whose package forky now provides
# at the same or newer version is GRADUATED and must be removed (the gate + the
# check-sid-exceptions tracker fail on it: "use forky").  Keep it small and
# columns (TAB): name version arch sha256 class forky_version gap reason
# class: B = small gap, rebuild planned; C = large gap/none, wait/replace.
# owner_action: rebuild | wait | replace (what we will do to remove it).
